colonyrank.settings.desc: In-game configuration for ColonyRank, including scoring mode, presets, language, and score multipliers.
colonyrank.settings.language.desc: Language used by in-game messages and Discord messages.
colonyrank.settings.scoringMode.desc: OLD = historical multiplier-based system. NEW = cross-product system linking stats (Population x Happiness, Level x Buildings).
colonyrank.settings.newPreset.desc: Preset for NEW scoring mode. Only used when scoring mode is NEW.
colonyrank.settings.populationMultiplier: Multiplier applied to the population score in OLD mode. Quota enforced across all five slots: 2x x5, 2x x10, and 1x x100.
colonyrank.settings.buildingMultiplier.d: Multiplier applied to the building count score in OLD mode. Quota enforced across all five slots: 2x x5, 2x x10, and 1x x100.
colonyrank.settings.averageBuildingLevel: Multiplier applied to the average building level score in OLD mode. Quota enforced across all five slots: 2x x5, 2x x10, and 1x x100.
colonyrank.settings.claimedChunksMultipl: Multiplier applied to claimed chunks in OLD mode. Quota enforced across all five slots: 2x x5, 2x x10, and 1x x100.
colonyrank.settings.overallHappinessMult: Multiplier applied to overall happiness in OLD mode. Quota enforced across all five slots: 2x x5, 2x x10, and 1x x100.
